_intent: 让访客理解 Linear 是为现代团队与 AI Agent 打造的产品开发系统，并注册开始使用

_title.text: The product development system for teams and agents

_summary.text: A new species of product tool. Purpose-built for modern teams with AI workflows at its core, Linear sets a new standard for planning and building products.

beats._intent: 产品能力的四个故事节拍：从输入到交付

_detail.text: Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
Plan and navigate from idea to launch. Align your team with product initiatives, strategic roadmaps, and clear, up-to-date PRDs.

_lines._intent: AI 与自动化在哪里生效

_detail.text: Build and deploy AI agents that work alongside you as teammates. Work on complex tasks together or delegate entire issues end-to-end.
Streamline code reviews with clear diffs, better context, and fewer back-and-forth comments. Keep PRs moving without sacrificing quality.

proof._intent: 用原则背书：这不是新玩具，而是被一流团队验证的实践

_summary.text: Linear is shaped by the practices and principles of world-class product teams.

_lines._intent: 为人类与 Agent 共享的工作流而设计

_detail.text: Designed for workflows shared by humans and agents. From drafting PRDs to pushing PRs.
Reduces noise and restores momentum to help teams ship with high velocity and focus.

changelog._intent: 持续演进的证据：按时间倒序的更新记录

_summary.text: Stacked pull requests are now displayed in Linear Diffs. Move through a stack and see review, CI, and merge status at a glance. Related PRs are grouped into a single collapsible row in Reviews, alongside their issue and project context.

_title.text: New controls for Linear coding agent

_summary.text: Coding sessions are the shortest path from issue to diff. Assign a task to Linear Agent, and it works in a secure cloud environment to write and test the code before opening a pull request for review.

Loops are recurring agent workflows for teams. They now respond to more workspace activity, including changes to initiatives, projects, and cycles. They can also edit Linear documents and post updates to Slack.

An active workspace can create a significant amount of notifications each day, and until now your inbox treated them all the same. The new Priority tab separates what needs your attention from what can wait, so something like a review blocking a release never gets buried.
